description:
Look up one brand, store or company by name: its cited parent company, ownership type, source links and,
    for scored brands, a Shoptegrity composite score (an opinion). Use it for a single known name. Fields without a
    cited source come back null and are listed as withheld. A name Shoptegrity does not have returns an error that
    is not a negative finding about the company.
name: lookup_brand
title: Look up a brand
